_comment: Single statement of which temp prefixes exist and who cleans them. kinds: scratch|evidence|test-lockgated|live|lock|worktree. First matching entry wins; patterns are globs (* and ?). _SRR_PATTERNS in hooks/tests/lib/suite-residue-reap.sh must equal the test-lockgated entries (hooks/tests/tmp-residue-registry.test.sh). Age-only deletion acts on scratch/evidence only. Optional `source` labels who writes an entry at runtime (session-hook = the live Claude session's hooks); new-since --exclude-source drops it.
